noveltyJustification: This pass identifies a lower-case sentence boundary the thin-continuity validator does not detect, a distinct runtime gap not recorded in earlier iterations.

label: P3 — Lowercase sentence starts can bypass the compact-field narrative check. The sentence-boundary regex counts punctuation only when it is followed by uppercase text or the end of the value. A short value such as Ready. fine. therefore counts only its final period. The remaining discourse check only looks for a fixed list of phrases, so this value can pass the length and token limits and be accepted as a two-sentence recent_action or next_safe_action despite the validator's compact, non-narrative requirement. The rejection test uses an uppercase second sentence and does not cover this boundary.
